mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies and temperatures at 61 degrees near City Hall. Under the waxing crescent moon, we are in for an exciting treat as the International Space Station passes by at 5:35 AM, rising over Mount Horeb and traveling almost directly overhead toward the Fitchburg and Madison area.

In city news, the Common Council recently approved new sewer and stormwater rates to ensure our utilities remain self-supporting and well-maintained. Also, we are celebrating our talented student artists, as the winners of the I Voted sticker contest have been selected for the November General Election.

There is plenty to do around town starting today, with the Epic Systems UGM, plus trivia nights happening today at both Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, be sure to catch the downtown farmer's market or join in for more trivia and live music at local favorites like Paddy Mac's.

In a look back at the police department's weekly report, on August 15, officers responded to a call regarding a driver who had swerved and stopped near North Main Street; the driver was subsequently arrested for a first offence O W I.

Today's flavor of the day is the mouth-watering Caramel Chocolate Pecan. The shop is currently closed but will be opening at 10 AM. If you are looking for tomorrow's treat, they will be serving Double Strawberry.
